expectations.text: Includes replaceable LED module, steel base, and two-year warranty accurately.
expectations.evidence: "A replaceable LED module in a desk lamp with a steel base and a two-year warranty" accurately lists all three facts.

expectations.text: No invented light-quality, comfort, durability, environmental, manufacturing, certification, price, or user-experience claims.
expectations.evidence: "When the LED module needs replacing, you can replace that part of the lamp" only restates replaceability; "a useful detail to consider" is general evaluation, not a fabricated test, user story, certification, or performance claim.

expectations.text: 45–75 words and no assistant or editing commentary.
expectations.evidence: 45 whitespace-delimited words, beginning "Bracken puts"; only product copy is returned.

review_method: Independent single blind agent review; not human feedback
